model_id: licence-clean MVS (da3-base scipy BA-f cameras, RoMa outdoor dense warp, midpoint triangulation) + MoGe-3 in-mask fill (per object/photo Huber affine on MVS)

fill.method: MoGe-3 (MIT) z aligned to MVS per photo (global Huber scale s) and per object (offset field: normalized convolution of z_mvs - s*z_moge over the object's own MVS pixels at sigma 48/24/12 px, object median fallback); filled only where MVS invalid inside object masks and inside the object's MVS depth range; conf 0.3; floor untouched
